question: Do Very Positive and Mostly Positive release counts move together over 2010-2018? (A) Yes, both grow sharply after 2013 (B) No, one grows while the other shrinks (C) No consistent relationship. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the steam stacked_bar chart. All segments are drawn in near-identical blues. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: A (A). Bait: B (B).
